properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLPrefixMapping object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLPrefixMapping object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object of the CustomXMLPrefixMapping object. Read-only.

properties.name: Prefix
properties.description: Gets the prefix for a CustomXMLPrefixMapping object. Read-only.

properties.name: NamespaceURI
properties.description: Gets the unique address identifier for the namespace of the CustomXMLPrefixMapping object. Read-only.
